name: Openstatus Hobby
free_limit: Ongoing $0 Hobby plan with 1 uptime monitor, 1 status page containing 3 components and minimum check interval of 10 minutes
watch_out: New workspaces start on a separate 14-day Starter trial with no card, then return to ongoing Hobby if not upgraded. Hobby needs no credit card; 1-minute checks, additional monitors, larger status pages and advanced alerting options are paid. Do not classify the trial's 14-day expiry as expiry of the Hobby Free plan.
